text: rebase and cherry-pick both pass "message" as $2 to prepare-commit-msg, identical to git commit -m, so $2 alone cannot tell a replayed message from one a human is writing — the sequencer state files (rebase-merge, rebase-apply, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD) are what distinguish them
